blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: The verdict follows the centralized bank-issued stablecoin model in Anchorage Digital's RDUSD announcement. RDUSD-specific holder-control powers have not yet been documented or verified on-chain.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Issuer-model inference only. Anchorage Digital Bank N.A. is the announced issuer and will operate minting, redemption, reserve management and custody. No verified public RDUSD deployment or token-specific freeze or blacklist authority was established in this review. The reviewed Yes records the announced centralized issuer model, not an observed exercise of holder controls.
